Excel formula calculation failed with #NAME? errors in the statistics section of the worksheet.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed because cells H46 through L47 returned #NAME? instead of the expected floating-point values. This error typically indicates the use of unrecognized function names or invalid named ranges in Excel formulas. While the 'net metric' matrix passed, the 'statistics' matrix assertion failed with multiple mismatches, such as H46 expecting -3.5737762237762265 but receiving #NAME?.
